description: This file implements an in-memory key-value store for Mattermost plugin API, including methods for setting, getting, deleting, and listing keys with concurrency safety and expiration handling.

classes.name: MemoryStore
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory key-value store implementation for Mattermost plugins.

classes.name: kvElem
classes.description: Represents a stored value with optional expiration time.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair with optional atomicity and expiration options.

methods.name: SetAtomicWithRetries
methods.description: Performs an atomic update with retries using a callback function.

methods.name: ListKeys
methods.description: Lists keys with pagination and optional filtering.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, unmarshalling JSON if necessary.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair by key.

methods.name: DeleteAll
methods.description: Removes all key-value pairs from the store.
